Functional Parity Catalog

Every case below is a complete JSON pricing request that is POSTed to the running Quantra server and whose returned NPV is asserted to match an independent QuantLib reference pricer (`tests/contract/ql_reference.py`) within a tolerance of 0.01. The cases, groupings and descriptions all come from one place — `tests/functional/manifest.py` — and the assertions run inside the standard gate (`bash tests/run_all_tests.sh`, suite 3). See `tests/functional/README.md` for how to add a case.

EUR 5Y payer swap, fixed 30/360 annual vs Euribor 6M
Standard EUR interest rate swap: pay 3.20% fixed (annual, 30/360) and receive Euribor 6M flat (semiannual, Act/360) on 10m notional, TARGET calendar, Modified Following. Single deposit+swap curve used for discounting and projection.

EUR 5Y receiver swap, fixed 30/360 annual vs Euribor 6M
The receiver side of the baseline trade: receive 3.40% fixed (annual, 30/360), pay Euribor 6M flat. Fixed rate is above the 5Y par rate, so the NPV is positive for the receiver.

EUR 5Y payer swap, +25bp floating spread, Following/Backward

EUR 1Y payer swap, money-market tenor
Short-dated 1Y swap: pay 2.90% fixed (a single annual 30/360 coupon) against two semiannual Euribor 6M coupons. The curve's short end (deposits + 1Y par swap) dominates, exercising the shortest tenor a fixed-vs-IBOR swap is quoted at.

EUR 30Y receiver swap, long-dated
Long-dated 30Y swap: receive 3.50% fixed (annual, 30/360), pay Euribor 6M flat, on a curve bootstrapped out to the 30Y par quote (2Y-30Y swaps). Exercises long-end bootstrapping and discounting over 60 semiannual floating periods.

EUR 5Y payer swap, 1Y forward starting
Forward-starting trade: a 5Y payer swap whose schedules begin one year after the valuation date (effective 2026-01-19 vs as-of 2025-01-15), so every coupon, including the first floating fixing, is projected off the curve. The classic pre-hedge / delayed-start structure.
